item.title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
item.description: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. item.description: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. item.description: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls.
